parsed.faithful: pound fet by in a clole veffel for fome weeks; after which it may be beaten Smooth with confidierably leis labour than at frift. This peel, and red role-buds, are commonly ground in a wooden mill made for that purpole.
parsed.modern: pound set by in a close vessel for some weeks; after which it may be beaten smooth with considerably less labour than at first. This peel, and red rose-buds, are commonly ground in a wooden mill made for that purpose.
